paragraphs: Southern Folger Detention Equipment Company designs, engineers and manufactures high-security locks, slider device locking systems and detention hardware. That company is dated to 1897 on the homepage, which calls it a designer and manufacturer of certified security and detention locking systems. The homepage places the company in San Antonio, Texas, within the Coastal Detention Holdings, LLC consortium, alongside American Steel Products and Trussbilt.

Three brands stand behind the name: Southern Steel, Folger Adam, and RR Brink Locking Systems. Southern Steel is dated to 1897 and described as the pioneer of detention equipment manufacturing. In 2023 the company acquired RR Brink Locking Systems.

Products are built to ASTM Certification standards, according to the about page. The same page places that equipment in correctional and detention facilities across the United States and around the world. Project management teams are described as working with architects, engineers, contractors, and facility managers on retrofits and larger facility projects. Southern Folger equipment is described as in use at state, federal, and private correctional institutions worldwide.

quote.text: At  Southern Folger , we specialize in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of  high-security locks, slider device locking systems, and detention hardware.
